svg.title: Use Case: Verify a Certificate Against a Trust Store

g.text: Use Case: Verify a Certificate Against a Trust Store
[a member certificate or CRL exists but cannot be read]
build path, check validity and revocation
Binding a store increments a per-client reference count and warms the store's
cache; a bind that cannot read an existing member certificate or CRL fails and
keeps no reference. Reset, close, or client cleanup releases the reference, and the
last release clears the cache without affecting another client's active store.
Anchors and CRLs come from enabled members only; a conditional member
whose content changed stays disabled until it is acknowledged. The CRL
set is used when CRL-based revocation checking is selected.
